title: termal_acknowledge_mailbox rejects a receipt that the same participant's read just returned ("mailbox receipt was not issued to this participant and mailbox")
outcome: A receipt returned by termal_read_mailbox to a participant can be used by that same participant to acknowledge the page; when it cannot, the refusal says why (no persisted page row, a different session identity, or an expired page) instead of a generic "not issued".
acceptance: The holder's note classifies, with file:line, why src/mailboxes.rs:2459-2468 found no mailbox_read_pages row for (receipt, mailbox_id, session_id) in the occurrence below. Where the live evidence needed to decide is unavailable (no host request log, no live-store read), it instead shows the miss irreproducible from source, with each candidate (session identity drift in the MCP bridge or the CLI, a receipt quoted from a message body, an uncommitted or rolled-back issuance, a page-row deletion, a host restart) ruled out with file:line evidence or left open with what would decide it.

A test fails on unchanged code and passes after the fix, showing that a receipt refusal names which binding failed: a receipt never issued (unknown), a receipt issued to the mailbox's other participant (without disclosing that session), or a receipt issued for a different mailbox. It also shows that no refused receipt moves the cursor, and that the receipt from the participant's own read still acknowledges.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
